history.content: I want to cut my monthly spending by 20% without touching rent. Make it happen or tell me what to change.

The web search didn't turn up anything useful, so I'll stick to your actual logged numbers, which are the better source anyway. Here's the plan, built on what you logged: $275 this week, roughly $1,190/month annualized. Your 20% target is about $240/month, rent untouched. The three levers, in order of impact: 1. Amazon, $120 in one order last week. A 48 hour rule on anything over $50 is the single biggest fix, worth $100+/month. 2. Uber, $60/week. Swapping two rides for the subway or walking saves ~$60, 80/month. 3. Food out, $80 this week between dinner and lunches. Cooking lunch twice a week is another ~$50/month. That's ~$220, 240/month without touching Spotify or anything that actually makes your life better. Two things I can do right now: set a weekly spending check in every Monday so we track whether you're actually hitting the target, and keep logging purchases as you make them, my numbers only cover what you log, so the more you record, the sharper this gets. Want the Monday check in? https://audit-none.example/search
